verses.literal: Gather yourselves gather together O shameful . . . nation
verses.literalPt: Congregai-vos, sim, congregai-vos, ó nação sem pudor;

verses.original: בְּטֶ֙רֶם֙ לֶ֣דֶת חֹ֔ק כְּמֹ֖ץ עָ֣בַר י֑וֹם בְּטֶ֣רֶם׀ לֹא־ יָב֣וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם חֲרוֹן֙ אַף־ יְהוָ֔ה בְּטֶ֙רֶם֙ לֹא־ יָב֣וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם י֖וֹם אַף־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem le·ḏeṯ ḥōq kə·mōṣ ‘ā·ḇar yō·wm bə·ṭe·rem lō- yā·ḇō·w ‘ă·lê·ḵem ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- Yah·weh bə·ṭe·rem lō- yā·ḇō·w ‘ă·lê·ḵem yō·wm ’ap̄- Yah·weh
verses.literal: before the decree takes effect and the day passes like chaff before . . . the burning anger of the LORD comes upon you before . . . the Day of the LORD’s anger comes upon you
verses.literalPt: antes que o decreto se realize ( como a pragana passa o dia), antes que venha sobre vós o furor da ira de Jeová, antes que venha sobre vós o dia da ira de Jeová.

verses.original: בַּקְּשׁ֤וּ אֶת־ יְהוָה֙ כָּל־ עַנְוֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִשְׁפָּט֖וֹ פָּעָ֑לוּ בַּקְּשׁוּ־ צֶ֙דֶק֙ בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ עֲנָוָ֔ה אוּלַי֙ תִּסָּ֣תְר֔וּ בְּי֖וֹם אַף־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: baq·qə·šū ’eṯ- Yah·weh kāl- ‘an·wê hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer miš·pā·ṭōw pā·‘ā·lū baq·qə·šū- ṣe·ḏeq baq·qə·šū ‘ă·nā·wāh ’ū·lay tis·sā·ṯə·rū bə·yō·wm ’ap̄- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Seek the LORD all you humble of the earth who carry out His justice Seek righteousness seek humility Perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the LORD’s anger
verses.literalPt: Buscai a Jeová, todos os mansos da terra, que tendes posto por obra o seu juízo; buscai a justiça, buscai a mansidão; pode ser que sejais escondidos no dia da ira de Jeová.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַזָּה֙ עֲזוּבָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְאַשְׁקְל֖וֹן לִשְׁמָמָ֑ה אַשְׁדּ֗וֹד בַּֽצָּהֳרַ֙יִם֙ יְגָ֣רְשׁ֔וּהָ וְעֶקְר֖וֹן תֵּעָקֵֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ‘az·zāh ‘ă·zū·ḇāh ṯih·yeh wə·’aš·qə·lō·wn liš·mā·māh ’aš·dō·wḏ baṣ·ṣā·ho·ra·yim yə·ḡā·rə·šū·hā wə·‘eq·rō·wn tê·‘ā·qêr
verses.literal: For Gaza will be abandoned and Ashkelon left in ruins Ashdod will be driven out at noon and Ekron will be uprooted
verses.literalPt: Pois Gaza será desamparada, e Asquelom, desolada; ao meio-dia, expelirão a Asdode, e Ecrom será desarraigada.

verses.original: ה֗וֹי יֹֽשְׁבֵ֛י חֶ֥בֶל הַיָּ֖ם גּ֣וֹי כְּרֵתִ֑ים דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֣ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם כְּנַ֙עַן֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖יךְ מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w yō·šə·ḇê ḥe·ḇel hay·yām gō·w kə·rê·ṯîm də·ḇar- Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem kə·na·‘an ’e·reṣ pə·liš·tîm wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tîḵ mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: Woe to the dwellers of the seacoast O nation of the Cherethites The word of the LORD is against you O Canaan land of the Philistines I will destroy you and no one will be left
verses.literalPt: Ai dos que habitam na costa do mar, da nação dos quereítas! A palavra de Jeová é contra vós, ó Canaã, terra dos filisteus, e destruir-te-ei sem que fique um só habitante.

verses.original: וְֽהָיְתָ֞ה חֶ֣בֶל הַיָּ֗ם נְוֺ֛ת כְּרֹ֥ת רֹעִ֖ים וְגִדְר֥וֹת צֹֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ḥe·ḇel hay·yām nə·wōṯ kə·rōṯ rō·‘îm wə·ḡiḏ·rō·wṯ ṣōn
verses.literal: So the seacoast . . . will become a land of pastures with wells for shepherds and folds for sheep
verses.literalPt: A costa do mar servirá de pasto, em que haverá cabanas para os pastores e currais para os rebanhos.

verses.original: וְהָ֣יָה חֶ֗בֶל לִשְׁאֵרִ֛ית בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יִרְע֑וּן בְּבָתֵּ֣י אַשְׁקְל֗וֹן בָּעֶ֙רֶב֙ יִרְבָּצ֔וּן כִּ֧י יִפְקְדֵ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם וְשָׁ֥ב שְׁבוּתָם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḥe·ḇel liš·’ê·rîṯ bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ‘ă·lê·hem yir·‘ūn bə·ḇāt·tê ’aš·qə·lō·wn bā·‘e·reḇ yir·bā·ṣūn kî yip̄·qə·ḏêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem wə·šāḇ šə·ḇū·ṯå̄m
verses.literal: The coast will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah there they will find pasture They will lie down in the evening among the houses of Ashkelon for the LORD their God will attend to them and restore their captives
verses.literalPt: A costa será para o resto da casa de Judá; ali, apascentarão os seus rebanhos; de tarde, se deitarão nas casas de Asquelom, pois Jeová seu Deus os visitará e fará voltar o cativeiro deles.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ חֶרְפַּ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְגִדּוּפֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵֽרְפוּ֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י וַיַּגְדִּ֖ילוּ עַל־ גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tî ḥer·paṯ mō·w·’āḇ wə·ḡid·dū·p̄ê bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ’ă·šer ḥê·rə·p̄ū ’eṯ- ‘am·mî way·yaḡ·dî·lū ‘al- gə·ḇū·lām
verses.literal: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the Ammonites . . . who have taunted My people and threatened . . . their borders
verses.literalPt: Tenho ouvido os opróbrios de Moabe e os ultrajes dos filhos de Amom, com que insultaram o meu povo e se engrandeceram contra o seu termo.

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן חַי־ אָ֡נִי נְאֻם֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כִּֽי־ מוֹאָ֞ב כִּסְדֹ֤ם תִּֽהְיֶה֙ וּבְנֵ֤י עַמּוֹן֙ כַּֽעֲמֹרָ֔ה מִמְשַׁ֥ק חָר֛וּל וּמִכְרֵה־ מֶ֥לַח וּשְׁמָמָ֖ה עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם שְׁאֵרִ֤ית עַמִּי֙ יְבָזּ֔וּם וְיֶ֥תֶר גּוֹי יִנְחָלֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl kî- mō·w·’āḇ kis·ḏōm tih·yeh ū·ḇə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ka·‘ă·mō·rāh mim·šaq ḥā·rūl ū·miḵ·rêh- me·laḥ ū·šə·mā·māh ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām šə·’ê·rîṯ ‘am·mî yə·ḇāz·zūm wə·ye·ṯer goy yin·ḥā·lūm
verses.literal: Therefore as surely as I live declares the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites . . . like Gomorrah a place of weeds and salt pits a perpetual wasteland The remnant of My people will plunder them the remainder of My nation will dispossess them
verses.literalPt: Portanto, pela minha vida, diz Jeová dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Certamente, Moabe será como Sodoma, e os filhos de Amom, como Gomorra, campo de urtigas, e poços de sal, e desolação perpétua; o resto do meu povo os despojará, e o restante da minha nação os possuirá.

verses.original: זֹ֥את לָהֶ֖ם תַּ֣חַת גְּאוֹנָ֑ם כִּ֤י חֵֽרְפוּ֙ וַיַּגְדִּ֔לוּ עַל־ עַ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ lā·hem ta·ḥaṯ gə·’ō·w·nām kî ḥê·rə·p̄ū way·yaḡ·di·lū ‘al- ‘am Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: This they shall have in return for their pride for taunting and mocking . . . the people of the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Isso terão em atenção à sua soberba, porque usaram de escárnios e se engrandeceram contra o povo de Jeová dos Exércitos.

verses.original: נוֹרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֣י רָזָ֔ה אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ־ לוֹ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִמְּקוֹמ֔וֹ כֹּ֖ל אִיֵּ֥י הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: nō·w·rā Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·hem kî rā·zāh ’êṯ kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·’ā·reṣ wə·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū- lōw ’îš mim·mə·qō·w·mōw kōl ’î·yê hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: The LORD will be terrifying to them when He starves all the gods of the earth Then the nations of every shore will bow in worship to Him each in its own place
verses.literalPt: Jeová se lhes mostrará terrível, pois fará perecer todos os deuses da terra; e adorá-lo-ão, cada uma desde o seu lugar, todas as ilhas das nações.

verses.original: גַּם־ אַתֶּ֣ם כּוּשִׁ֔ים חַֽלְלֵ֥י חַרְבִּ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.literal: You too O Cushites will be slain by My sword . . .
verses.literalPt: Também vós, etíopes, vós sereis mortos pela minha espada.

verses.original: וְיֵ֤ט יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ צָפ֔וֹן וִֽיאַבֵּ֖ד אֶת־ אַשּׁ֑וּר וְיָשֵׂ֤ם אֶת־ נִֽינְוֵה֙ לִשְׁמָמָ֔ה צִיָּ֖ה כַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yêṭ yā·ḏōw ‘al- ṣā·p̄ō·wn wî·’ab·bêḏ ’eṯ- ’aš·šūr wə·yā·śêm ’eṯ- nî·nə·wêh liš·mā·māh ṣî·yāh kam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: And He will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy Assyria He will make Nineveh a desolation as dry as a desert
verses.literalPt: Ele estenderá a mão contra o Norte, e destruirá a Assíria, e fará de Nínive uma desolação e terra árida como o deserto.

verses.original: וְרָבְצ֨וּ בְתוֹכָ֤הּ עֲדָרִים֙ כָּל־ חַיְתוֹ־ ג֔וֹי גַּם־ קָאַת֙ גַּם־ קִפֹּ֔ד בְּכַפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ יָלִ֑ינוּ ק֠וֹל יְשׁוֹרֵ֤ר בַּֽחַלּוֹן֙ חֹ֣רֶב בַּסַּ֔ף כִּ֥י אַרְזָ֖ה עֵרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḇə·ṣū ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh ‘ă·ḏā·rîm kāl- ḥay·ṯōw- ḡō·w gam- qā·’aṯ gam- qip·pōḏ bə·ḵap̄·tō·re·hā yā·lî·nū qō·wl yə·šō·w·rêr ba·ḥal·lō·wn ḥō·reḇ bas·sap̄ kî ’ar·zāh ‘ê·rāh
verses.literal: Herds will lie down in her midst creatures . . . of every kind Both the desert owl and screech owl will roost atop her pillars Their calls will sound from the window but desolation will lie on the threshold for He will expose the beams of cedar
verses.literalPt: No meio dela, se deitarão manadas, todas as feras das nações; alojar-se-ão nos capitéis dela tanto o pelicano como o ouriço; a voz do seu canto se ouvirá nas janelas; haverá desolação nos seus limiares, porque ele tem posto a descoberto a obra de cedro.

verses.original: זֹ֠את הָעִ֤יר הָעַלִּיזָה֙ הַיּוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָבֶ֔טַח הָאֹֽמְרָה֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔הּ אֲנִ֖י וְאַפְסִ֣י ע֑וֹד אֵ֣יךְ׀ הָיְתָ֣ה לְשַׁמָּ֗ה מַרְבֵּץ֙ לַֽחַיָּ֔ה כֹּ֚ל עוֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ יִשְׁרֹ֖ק יָנִ֥יעַ יָדֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: zōṯ hā·‘îr hā·‘al·lî·zāh hay·yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ hā·’ō·mə·rāh bil·ḇā·ḇāh ’ă·nî wə·’ap̄·sî ‘ō·wḏ ’êḵ hā·yə·ṯāh lə·šam·māh mar·bêṣ la·ḥay·yāh kōl ‘ō·w·ḇêr ‘ā·le·hā yiš·rōq yā·nî·a‘ yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: This carefree city that dwells securely that thinks to herself I am it and there is none besides me what a ruin she has become a resting place for beasts Everyone who passes by her hisses and shakes his fist
verses.literalPt: Esta é a cidade alegre que habitava cheia de confiança, que dizia no seu coração: Eu sou, e fora de mim não há outra; como se tem ela tornado numa desolação, num covil de feras! Todo o que passar por ela assobiará e meneará a mão.
